metaDescription: Explore our directory of financial consultancy services in Nepal: corporate finance, personal planning, business advisory, bookkeeping, tax, and registration.
directAnswer: Explore our complete suite of financial consultancy and business support services in Nepal. From personal financial planning and corporate cash-flow forecasting to bookkeeping setup, tax compliance, and company registration, we provide structured advisory for every stage of your financial journey.
author: Lalitpur Advisory Research Desk

sections.contentHtml:
Select any practice area below to explore service scopes, deliverables, engagement processes, and interactive financial tools:

Financial Consultancy Services

Strategic financial management, cash-flow structuring, budgeting, and compliance guidance across all seven provinces.

View Service Details →

Personal Financial Planning

Practical household budgeting in NPR, 50/30/20 cash allocation, emergency funds, and structured debt reduction.

View Service Details →

Business Financial Consulting

Rolling cash-flow forecasting, working capital optimization, break-even modeling, and executive management reporting.

View Service Details →

Accounting & Bookkeeping

Systematic transaction recording, bank reconciliations, VAT registers, and coordinating with independent statutory auditors.

View Service Details →

Tax Planning & Compliance

Lawful tax structuring, advance tax installment planning, e-TDS reconciliation, and preparation for IRD filing.

View Service Details →

Business Registration & Licensing

OCR Private Limited incorporation, Municipal Ward permitting, PAN/VAT setup, and post-incorporation Share Lagat.

View Service Details →

faqs.question: Can I engage your firm for a single project without an ongoing retainer?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer both project-based consulting (e.g. business registration, cash-flow model setup, tax documentation review) and retained advisory services for ongoing monthly support.
